name: Ashita no Tame ni Dekiru ko to
original_name: 明日の為に出来ること
source:
A rural village surrounded by mountains and the sea.
There is a girl that is anxious about her future.
There is a guy that doesn't have a care in the world.
They meet and together, take one step toward her future.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ193060.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一个依山傍海的乡村。
有一个女孩，她对自己的未来感到焦虑。
世上有一个人，是无忧无虑的。
他们相遇并一起，向她的未来迈出了一步。

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ193060.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英语[/url]]
